verdict.rationale: Brex documents instant virtual card creation in Bill Pay for paying vendors by card ("spin up virtual cards in one click"), alongside physical and virtual corporate cards and procurement limits. A community user also praises the dynamic card generator. Nothing shows a card can be locked to a single vendor or merchant, or that SaaS subscriptions get dedicated per-vendor cards to isolate a compromise. missing for 10: documented single-vendor/merchant-locking on virtual cards, explicit SaaS subscription card workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of vendor-isolated cards.
